debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r i-n-t-e-r-f-e-r-e-d w-i-t-h d-r-o-n-e n-a-v i-g a-t-i-o-n s-i-g n-a-l-s, l-e-f-t r-a-d-i-o f-r-e-q u-e-n-c-y l-o-g s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d l-i-c-e-n-s-e d t-e-s-t i-n-g a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-a-t-i-o-n.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-e-c-o-d-e-d t-h-e d-e-l-i-v-e-r-y r-o-u-t-e d-a-t-a, l-e-f-t d-e-c-r-y-p-t-e-d p-a-c-k-a-g-e m-a-n-i-f-e-s-t s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d p-e-r-m-i-s-s-i-o-n f-o-r s-y-s-t-e-m a-c-c-e-s-s.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-p-o-o-f-e-d t-h-e g-p-s c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e s, l-e-f-t f-a-l-s-e w-a-y-p-o-i-n-t l-o-g s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d g-e-o-f-e-n-c-e v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r m-i-s-d-i-r-e-c-t-e-d t-h-e d-r-o-n-e s t-o t-h-e d-e-p-o-t, l-e-f-t l-a-n-d-i-n-g s-c-e-n-e p-h-o-t-o-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d o-p-e-r-a-t-i-o-n-a-l s-a-f-e-t-y c-h-e-c-k-s.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-e-p-o-r-t-e-d a n-o-r-m-a-l s-i-g n-a-l i-s-s-u-e, l-e-f-t d-i-s-m-i-s-s-i-v-e i-n-c-i-d-e-n-t r-e-c-o-r-d s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y r-e-v-i-e-w-s.
